headline: AI blamed for 116,175 US job cuts this year
body: A quiet day of small items. Challenger counted 116,175 AI-attributed US job cuts so far in 2026, about 22% of the total, a dent in Shared Prosperity. The Justice Department backed OpenAI's fair-use defence in the NYT case, a nudge toward Power Concentration, and an AI-drafted Texas police report on a licence-plate camera search added to Surveillance & Control. Horizon Balance slipped to -2.70.
movers_note: Only small moves today: 1984 +0.08, from the DOJ filing (+0.04) and the Axon report (+0.04); Egalitarian Utopia -0.05, from the Challenger job-cut count (-0.04) and the DOJ filing (-0.04), partly offset by fading earlier news (+0.02).
